# Kopuz

> Kopuz is a free, open-source music player for Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android. It puts local files, SMB shares on a NAS, self-hosted servers (Jellyfin, Navidrome and other Subsonic servers, Nextcloud), Clippsly, and streaming services (YouTube Music, Apple Music, SoundCloud, Spotify) in one library. It's licensed under the EUPL 1.2.

## Pages

- [Features](https://kopuz.moe/features): sources, lyrics, playlists, themes, playback, and integrations
- [Download](https://kopuz.moe/download): installers for every platform, plus Flatpak, AUR, Nix, Cargo, and Google Play
- [Support](https://kopuz.moe/support): sponsors, donations, and community links

## Guides

- [Nextcloud](https://kopuz.moe/guides/nextcloud): connect over WebDAV with an app password
- [SMB and NAS](https://kopuz.moe/guides/smb): play from an SMB share without mounting it
- [YouTube Music](https://kopuz.moe/guides/youtube-music): browser sign-in or anonymous mode
- [Apple Music](https://kopuz.moe/guides/apple-music): sign-in, Widevine on desktop, Android status
- [SoundCloud](https://kopuz.moe/guides/soundcloud): one-time browser sign-in
- [Spotify](https://kopuz.moe/guides/spotify): developer app, Client ID, Spotify Connect
- [Clippsly](https://kopuz.moe/guides/clippsly): app password, locker streaming, uploads
